# =============================================================================
# requirements-stats.txt — the environment for --step STATS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Exact versions that produced the downstream statistics. Install with
#     bash scripts/analysis/setup_stats_env.sh
# which builds a venv at <dataRoot>/envs/stats.
#
# WHY A SEPARATE ENVIRONMENT
#   The profiling tools (bwa-mem2, Kraken 2, Bracken, Kaiju, fastp, samtools)
#   live in the conda env `cancer`. Installing a scientific Python stack into
#   that env while a 563-sample run is using it risks pulling a shared
#   dependency out from under a running job. A venv cannot do that: it is a
#   separate prefix and the conda env is never modified.
#
#   It also keeps the two concerns honest — changing a statistics library must
#   never invalidate a profiling result, and vice versa.
#
# PYTHON: 3.12.13 (the interpreter the venv is built from)
# =============================================================================

# tables — polars is the project convention, never pandas
polars==1.43.2
pyarrow==25.0.1

# numerics: the exact permutation enumeration and the CLR transform
numpy==2.5.2

# Wilcoxon signed-rank, used as the rank-based cross-check
scipy==1.18.0

# Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across taxa
statsmodels==0.14.6
patsy==1.0.2
